Cpad for Gespage V6 application release notes:
---------------------------------------------
[v2.1.0] 14/09/2016
- Support for cPad v1 and v2 devices
- Improvement of the user interface with flat design
- Improvement in skins management. Separate skins can be installed in the cPad. The current skin in use is specified by a new parameter "skin"
- Extend parameter "kbd_beep" to enable/disable all key beeps
- Various fixes for new cPad v2 hardware platform.

[v2.0.2] 26/08/2016
- Support for cPad v2 hardware platform.
- Known issue: This version is not compatible with cPad v1 hardware platform.
- Known issue: VNC remote connection is unstable on cPad v2 hardware platform.

[v1.17.1] 25/08/2016
- RISO: Fix random print job release interruption in case of release all.

[v1.17.0] 03/05/2016
- CNOUS: Fix rare case of cPad freeze on TCM3 initialization after a reboot.

[v1.16.15] 14/04/2016
- RISO : Do not allow print job release while printer is turned off.
- Add tcm3-hid driver support

[v1.16.14] 24/03/2016
- Fix tcm3 reader connection error message displayed while reader working properly

[v1.16.13] 17/03/2016
- RISO : Fix random crash in big copy sessions after copy status requests

[v1.16.12] 10/03/2016
- RISO : Improve print jobs polling process to fix issues with device interrupting big print sessions, opening copy session before finishing print session. 
- Minor changes in card reading display : change messages and remove blinking messages.

[v1.16.11] 02/03/2016
- Fix random device freeze when Gespage server gets unavailable while device is working
- Cpad VNC server activated by default

[v1.16.10] 26/01/2016
- Fix merge copy user with an existing user in print code authentication mode
- Fix wrong display of print jobs details pages
- Improve reader test menu display

le while device is working
- Cpad VNC server activated by default

[v1.16.10] 26/01/2016
- Fix merge copy user with an existing user in print code authentication mode
- Fix wrong display of print jobs details pages
- Improve reader test menu display to avoid a crash when testing tcm3 reader

[v1.16.9] 18/01/2016
- CNOUS : Fix tcm3 reader freezes after several card short swaps.

[v1.16.8] 08/01/2016
- Fix Konica Minolta issue : wrong copy count if an ongoing copy session is interrupted.
- Update displayed messages in case a open copy session request fails ( new messages for error 401 and 409)

[v1.16.7] 11/12/2015
- Use a default config.xml to handle occasionally config.xml file corruption

[v1.16.6] 01/12/2015
- Add an advanced parameter to activate keyboard beep ("kbd_beep")
- CNOUS: Add a popup screen to indicate card reading in process
- CNOUS: Improve reliability on SAM connection
- RISO: Fix a lockup when screen inactivity was reached at the same time than a user logout request
- Billing codes: Fix rare case of billing code search failure
- Upgrade: Fix a regression on automatic update from v1.16.3

[v1.16.5] 26/11/2015
- CNOUS : Add a popup screen to indicate card reading in process
- RISO : Fix a crash when screen inactivity was reached at the same time than a user logout request

[v1.16.0] 12/10/2015
- CNOUS : return the card id for cartadis Mifare cards
- CNOUS : handle izly desfire 4k cards
- DHCP client update (dhcpcd v6.9.3)

[v1.15.1] 03/08/2015
- Fix "sam disconnected" wrong error message when not in cnous mode
- Fix serial card reader failure after update of the parameters or network loss
- Fix TCRS reader test menu

[v1.15.0] 07/07/2015
- CNOUS : MIFARE Classic cards support
- CNOUS : add the SAM serial number as an information parameter in gespage serve

- Fix serial card reader failure after update of the parameters or network loss
- Fix TCRS reader test menu

[v1.15.0] 07/07/2015
- CNOUS : MIFARE Classic cards support
- CNOUS : add the SAM serial number as an information parameter in gespage server
- CNOUS : Fix wrong behavior when trying to connect a new user while another user is already connected
- Use force numeric Keyboard parameters in user association popup ("printcode_force_numeric_kbd", "username_force_numeric_kbd", "password_force_numeric_kbd")
- Fix copy screen display issue, randomly displaying duplicated formats and erroneous copy counts
- Minor changes in network error display messages

[v1.14.6] 23/06/2015
- Add tcm3-legic driver support

[v1.14.5] 08/06/2015
- Fix regression on default prices management 
- CNOUS mode : fix crash when sam module is disconnected

[v1.14.4] 29/05/2015
- Fix network requests collision when making several repeated authentications
- Reduce connection time in Konica Vendor2 mode

[v1.14.3] 16/03/2015
- Fix issue with cpad slowness over time. Better memory management 

[v1.14.2] 18/02/2015
- Add "refresh" button in jobs list screen
- cPad registration name on server will now use the cPad name if available instead of serial (requires Gespage 7.0.0)
- Add German translation file
- Corrections to Spanish keyboard (using Qwerty and adding special Spanish characters)

[v1.14.1] 14/01/2015
- Fix specific RISO printers issue : enable copier before sending printing jobs (use advanced parameter "printer-riso� to enable that mode)

[v1.14.0] 21/11/2014
- New screen displayed during firmware upgrade to provide upgrade progress and errors, improvement of upgrade procedure, and reduction of firmware size.
- Fixes for FAX & SCAN management in Konica Minolta MFPs

] 21/11/2014
- New screen displayed during firmware upgrade to provide upgrade progress and errors, improvement of upgrade procedure, and reduction of firmware size.
- Fixes for FAX & SCAN management in Konica Minolta MFPs
- Fix card authentication failure when association of card id to user is disabled in Gespage
- Better handling of end cycle on SNMP drivers to never miss copies done during disconnection (increases the disconnection delay).
- Add new MFP driver file (parallel_duplex.if) to allow A3 format opto to be used to detect duplex (possible on some Xerox MFP).
- Support of new card reader (file ideco.rdr)
- Add Norwegian translation file(no_NO.glang)
NOTE! From this version, upgrade from old cPad firmware may require to use firmware-factory upgrade first.

[v1.13.2] 02/09/2014
- Fix issue where configuration menu can't be displayed (regression from 1.13.0)

[v1.13.1] 22/08/2014
- CNOUS mode : Add support for user card self-association
- CNOUS mode : Fix card reader stopped after recovering from a network loss
- Support of new Cartadis TCMAG2-USB card reader (file tcmag2-usb.rdr)
- Add Polish translation
- Logs: Reduce the log history to 7 days

[v1.13.0] 02/07/2014
- Improvements in network errors management.
- Add a new parameter to choose prefered screen directly displayed at login (param : "prefered_screen_after_login", values : "copy" -> directly display copy screen)
- Add support for customized language message file (messages defined in file customized_msg.glang won't be erased when updating the firmware)
- Fix random case where cPad was rebooting periodically.

[v1.12.9] 23/05/2014
- Add a new parameter ("auto_switch_to_copy_after_print") to handle automatic switch to copy screen after releasing all jobs. If parameter set to "0" then no automatic switch t

random case where cPad was rebooting periodically.

[v1.12.9] 23/05/2014
- Add a new parameter ("auto_switch_to_copy_after_print") to handle automatic switch to copy screen after releasing all jobs. If parameter set to "0" then no automatic switch to copy screen.
- Fix to handle corrupted cPad configuration. If this occurs, the default configuration is applied and the network parameters and server address would have to be configured again.

[v1.12.8] 30/04/2014
- Support authentication with a CNOUS Desfire purse card

[v1.12.7] 21/03/2014
- Fix a random issue with user unexpectedly disconnected but copier remaining started, allowing free copies.
- In SNMP mode, wait for counters to be initialized before starting the copier to avoid free copies if the network is not available

[v1.12.6] 03/03/2014
- Fix no inactivity timeout in print jobs screen at first display.
- Fix user input popup not properly deleted before print jobs display in operator mode.
- Add driver for Salto iButton Dallas 1973 reader

[v1.12.5] 11/02/2014
- Support of US formats "letter" and "legal" in SNMP
- Fix aleatory crash in SNMP session when printer inactivity timeout is reached
- Full support of serial barcode reader
- Fix an application freeze after cancelling an association of a copy card with an existing user.

[v1.12.4] 06/01/2014
- Fix major login issue in user/password mode, automatically disconnecting user 30 secondes after login.

[v1.12.3] 02/01/2014
- Allow connection for "copy" users with no credit to authorize association with an existing account
- Fix errors when associating a "copy" users to an existing account
- Fix errors with cpad untimely sending wrong absolute counters

[v1.12.2] 29/11/2013
- Fix a crash when release all jobs with several pages
- Management of "copy" users card

ccount
- Fix errors when associating a "copy" users to an existing account
- Fix errors with cpad untimely sending wrong absolute counters

[v1.12.2] 29/11/2013
- Fix a crash when release all jobs with several pages
- Management of "copy" users card authentication failures
- Modification of parameter "copier_ip" from server is correctly managed in the Cpad
- Fix formats display issue in Konica Minolta Vendor 2 mode. Do not display formats which prices are set to 0
- New printer drivers for Ricoh MP2501, Ricoh MPC2051 ans Xerox WC7225
- Change copy commands button label from "copy" to "copy/scan"
- Management of 2 generations of TCMAG1-USB reader (tcmag-usb.rdr for old generation, tcmag1-usb.rdr for new generation)

[v1.12.1] 06/11/2013
- Full duplex support in SNMP mode
- Fix a crash on network parameters display when no DNS servername is defined in the cpad
- Full support of "scan" format
- Handle anonymous copy accounts and operators accounts
- Handle merging of anonymous copy accounts with standards users accounts.
- Add italian translations
- Better handling of keyboard switching according to language change
- Automatic redirection to prints jobs screen after activity selection if print jobs are present
- Correct management of print jobs charging rules(some jobs can be charged only to the activity but not to user, or both)
- TCMAG USB reader full support
- Modification of prices format from 0,00 to 0.00.

[v1.10] 26/06/2013
- Better error handling when a user is connected simultaneously in 2 different cpads
- Add a new parameter ("jobcode-request") to ensure the activity is always requested when selecting an action (e.g. from print screen to copy screen with activity selection)
- Add new parameters for each input widget to be used in numeric mode by default.(Paramet

arameter ("jobcode-request") to ensure the activity is always requested when selecting an action (e.g. from print screen to copy screen with activity selection)
- Add new parameters for each input widget to be used in numeric mode by default.(Parameters names : "username_force_numeric_kbd" "password_force_numeric_kbd" "printcode_force_numeric_kbd" "activity_search_force_numeric_kbd") 
- Fix minor english translation error

[v1.9] 23/04/2013
- New configuration tool design
- Addition of second DNS support in configuration tool
- Management of two USB readers simultaneously
- Support of user authentication in mode card + pin
- Fix to ensure automatic software keeps user settings such as skins,language and keyboard layout.
- Fix security issue with password displayed not hidden in some cases
- Allow copier daemon to be automatically restarted if any crash occurs
- Password fields are disabled until the login fields are filled
- Add swedish and spanish translations
- Minor fixes to display effective startup messages.
- Gespage Logo update

[v1.8] 20/12/2012
- Addition of Kyocera MFP driver 
- Better handling of print jobs refreshment after release error
- Better handling of network loss during a copy session.
- Fix single activity handling error : If a only one activity is available, it is automatically selected when starting the copy or print session
- Fix to improve automatic software update.
- Fix card association errors in pin code mode
- Fix in copy session closing after unexpected errors
- Better handling of card events during copy session closing
- Minor keyboard issue : wrong character displayed instead of "\" in english language

[v1.7] 29/11/2012
- DHCP client update to DHCPD v5.5.6
- Pagination of the print jobs list
- Better handling of the automatic firmware up

ring copy session closing
- Minor keyboard issue : wrong character displayed instead of "\" in english language

[v1.7] 29/11/2012
- DHCP client update to DHCPD v5.5.6
- Pagination of the print jobs list
- Better handling of the automatic firmware update process. If something goes wrong and the update is not completed, the cpad
 launches the firmware update again at the next restart.
- Fix bad behaviors when the CPad is not connected to a MFP or deleted from the server.
- Handling of absolute copy counters for server session checking
- Copies made after the logout has been requested (during the logout timeout) are correctly counted
- Fix a card reading error. Sometimes the cardId was incomplete causing the user to associate the card again.
- The cpad handles a new server parameter to set the MFP interface via the server
- Better handling of printing errors. The error details is displayed in an error popup
- Better handling of missing messages. An error message containing the message code is displayed instead.
- Incorrect credit display and wrong debit reported when an unlimited user selects a limited activity
- Addition of a random delay (0 to 15 min) in the reboot time to avoid all the cpads to reboot at the same time.
- The card number is no longer displayed when logging in
- Fix minor issues with information and error popup display (sometimes titles and messages were switched)
- Addition of rfideas usb reader driver
- Addition of a timeout in the card association popup
- VNC: simultaneous display of the cpad screen in vnc mode in the computer screen and the cpad

[v1.4] 29/06/2012
- DHCP client update
- Fixed some login screen display errors
- Change Keyboard mode for login mode Card-password
- Fixed issue in activity screen. Last activity was not always displayed
-

mode in the computer screen and the cpad

[v1.4] 29/06/2012
- DHCP client update
- Fixed some login screen display errors
- Change Keyboard mode for login mode Card-password
- Fixed issue in activity screen. Last activity was not always displayed
- Fixed issue with tCM3 software beep in conflict with keypad beep

[v1.3] 07/06/2012
- Display the current version in Login screen
- Management of network cable unplug
- Fix crashes in activity selection screen
- Enhancement in the reboot after a crash, only the main application is restarted
- TCM3 software beep management
- New network driver integration
- New LCD driver integration
- Fixed issues with the screensaver
- Fixed some login screen display errors
